parts.name: enclosure-back-top
parts.model_overhangs_review: This exact ceiling-down slice has 11 measured support bodies, 38 explicit interface islands and one unlabelled exterior ribbon; total island count and overall shortest build-up remain unknown. Each contact has a named open cleanup route. The C14 seating floor, pan bearing floor, round seats, tie channels, snap shoulders and broad seam-foot faces remain intact. Supports are detached in branches while the quadrant is empty; neither one-piece extraction of the connected tree nor low cleanup force is inferred. The exact emitted-layer diagnostic assessment is complete and linked; its raw findings, saved-bead/first-layer analysis and bounded limitations remain explicit.

trees.contact_region: Connected exterior bed tree with 29 separately labeled contacts: funnel bearing, C14 bore/pocket, ASSE seats/shared tie threshold and pan berth, west anchors, rear identification/keystone/nameplate pockets, PRV mouth and all three rear seam-foot runs.
trees.removal_lane: Separate accessible branches while the quadrant is loose. Use each interface row’s named lane: the empty funnel opening; C14 bore or fore flange approach; +X from side cradles; −Z from the ASSE/tie lower mouths; −X through the pan opening; +Y from shallow rear pockets; −Y behind the nameplate receiver; and inboard then −Z from the open rail channels. Remove outer trunks after their branches are detached. No single rigid whole-tree extraction is claimed.
trees.removal_direction_original_cad: Per-contact directions are specified on all 29 interface rows; branch detachment precedes withdrawal.
trees.preserved_working_face_reason: Each bearing, locating, retention and access face retains its full working profile; cleanup occurs before any component blocks a mouth.

native_log_diagnostics_review: The ZFiller clipping-vertex tag 1725 is retained; it is not a layer or coordinate. Its exact-archive diagnostic assessment checks all 813 native/scheduled/model layers, 1,969 section components and 2,824,211 raw boundary samples. The three absent raw tips are 0.04005/0.08001/0.32001 mm wide and vanish under the saved 0.42 mm classic-wall bead with thin-wall detection disabled. Every printable-width section and sampled boundary is present. The first layer is checked with the saved 0.15 mm elephant-foot inset and 0.50 mm bead, keeping the same 0.20 mm diagnostic margin; its worst remaining boundary gap is 0.035926 mm. Raw findings and a successful synthetic omitted-road negative control remain in support-evidence/back-top-emission. This bounded presence proof does not claim interior infill completeness, physical strength or universal harmlessness of the slicer diagnostic. The three other messages are profile-authored T1001/T65535/T65279 startup/end control tokens.
